'''Sull Caxe''' was a commanding officer for the [[Republic Army]]. He was in command during a planned raid on an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] factory on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Before the raid, [[Amity (individual)|Amity]],<ref name="Visions of the Past" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] in the Republic Army,<ref name="Season 4">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230328|text=Galactic Season 4 "A Passage of Peace"}}</ref> reported experiencing a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of a devastating outcome involving heavy casualties, including Republic forces, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] militia, Imperial troops, and civilians in the sector. Caxe dismissed the warning and instructed him not to share the vision with others.<ref name="Visions of the Past" />

The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]], the raid proceeded and resulted in the destruction most of the sector and heavy casualities. Amity was one of the survivors and later discovered that Caxe had accepted a payment from [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in exchange for revealing details of the planned raid. Caxe was reportedly arrested but disappeared prior to his trial.<ref name="Visions of the Past" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sull Caxe was first mentioned in a conversation with Amity, a companion which players could obtain in the Galactic Season 4 "A Passage of Peace" event, introduced in [[March]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.2.1,<ref name="Season 4" /> as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
